name: chessalyzer
description: Compose chess engines from components and compare them over suites of exemplars, in a UI

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/web
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names server,web "npm run dev -w @chessalyzer/server" "npm run dev -w @chessalyzer/web"
